guarantees.claim: absorbed_o is reset to prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False when rst_ni is low; otherwise, absorbed_o is updated to the value of absorbed on every rising clock edge.

assumptions.claim: The input signal 'absorbed' must meet setup/hold timing relative to clk_i and be free of glitches/spurious toggles not representing the true absorption status.
assumptions.cond: Always, but especially when the SHA-3 operation is in progress.
assumptions.risk: If absorbed transiently changes during a clock edge, absorbed_o could register an incorrect value, possibly indicating completion before actual absorption, which may cause downstream logic to proceed prematurely and potentially expose intermediate hash state or cause control flow errors.
